buffs.name: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
buffs.notes: Drink to increase the effectiveness of your spells. You gain 3 stacks of Arcane Acuity until your next long rest. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

buffs.name: Elixir of Bloodlust
buffs.notes: Drink to enter a bloodlust. Once per turn when you kill a foe, you gain 5 and an additional action. * Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

buffs.name: Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength
buffs.notes: Consume the elixir to increase your Strength to 27. * Replaces effects of other elixirs when drunk. action

buffs.name: Elixir of Heroism
buffs.notes: Gain 10 and a d4 Slashing 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and SavingThrows until the next long rest.

buffs.name: Elixir of Hill Giant Strength
buffs.notes: Consume the elixir to increase your Strength to 21. * Replaces effects of other elixirs when drunk. action

buffs.name: Elixir of Viciousness
buffs.notes: The number you need to roll to land a Critical Hit is reduced by 1. ** Some class features reduce the Critical Hit number; this elixir's effect is additive * Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

buffs.name: Elixir of the Colossus
buffs.notes: Drink to increase your size. Weapons deal an additional 1d4 damage. You gain Advantage on Strength Checks and saves.
